verdict.rationale: Clara documents a public API covering cards, transactions, users and invoices. It publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 schema and LLM-optimized API references; probes confirm the openapi.json, llms.txt and markdown docs are live. Self-serve dashboard credentials, a sandbox, runnable per-language code examples and registrable webhooks make it practical to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actual API calls succeeding beyond the docs probes.
